Thanks for contributing to GEOscouter. Pull requests should target **`dev`** and stay focused on one feature or fix.

## Checklist

- [ ] Targets branch **`dev`**
- [ ] Tests pass locally (`python -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py'`) or CI is green
- [ ] If `geoscouter/core/` or library behavior changed, tests were added or updated when reasonable
- [ ] Linked issue #____ (optional for small fixes)

## Notes for reviewer

How I tested (e.g. which app steps, example `gds_result.txt`):

If AI tools generated a substantial part of this PR, say so here for transparency.
